record.question: The Mayor, with his Counselor, ___________ to be present.
record.explanation: Answer A: is. The head subject is singular “Mayor”. The parenthetical “with his Counselor” does not turn it into a plural subject; “is” agrees. Original paper prints three choices; the empty imported fourth slot was removed after visual source inspection. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no examiner key is asserted.
